note: Single source of truth for the hand-eye calibration in use. To switch calibration, edit this file; do not edit code. Read through tools/active_calib.py.
Convention: q_true = q_meas + joint_offsets_rad (motor order, radians). J1 of the reference arm and J7 are fixed to 0.
Replace the two 'from' entries with the joint_result.json written by tools/handeye_joint_solve.py (path relative to this directory).

left.warn: No joint offsets for this arm in the result file; zeros are used.

hand_mount.note: Transform from the last arm joint frame (wrist roll, tool0) to the L6 hand_base_link. End-to-end value for the standard mounting. Code entry: robot/conventions.hand_mount_T() and active_calib.load().
